The town's climate is generally wet and partly cloudy year-round.
Climate trends show a warming pattern, with winter experiencing the most significant increase in temperature.
The climate data suggests that daily life and local events would need to accommodate hot, humid summers and cool winters. Outdoor activities are best suited for spring and fall.
Annual precipitation is consistent, but year-to-year variability exists.
